items.claim: El Chapo has cut his teeth primarily in the European promotion Octagon MMA.
items.quote: this is a guy who for the most part cut his teeth for the promotion Octagon MMA in Europe.

items.claim: El Chapo likes to get right in his opponents' faces from the opening bell and throw wild haymakers.
items.quote: He likes to get right in his opponent's faces and just throw bombs. It's really not that technical, but it is a lot of fun.

items.claim: El Chapo holds a professional record of 14 wins and 3 losses.
El Chapo has not faced as high a caliber of competition as Gilbert Urbina.
items.quote: he hasn't faced as high of caliber as competition as Gilbert Erbina.

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina has a professional record of 7 wins and 4 losses.
items.quote: it's not the best. It's seven and four

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina's losses are against elite-level competition including Eros Medic, Charles Radtke, Brian Battle, and Sean Brady.
items.quote: the guy his only losses are to Eros Medic who's gonna be in the main event against Daniel Rodriguez, Charles Ratkkey and Radkkeyy's on a tear right now, Brian Battle... and then before that Shawn Brady

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina is very tall, very rangy, and is best suited to fight at 185 pounds.
items.quote: they're both very very tall, very rangy, very big. And it surprises me that Gilbert was able to kind of hang around 170 pounds for as long as he did because he's a really really big guy.

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina possesses good long-range weapons, a really good teep kick, straight punches, and a deceptively good front choke game.
items.quote: good at using his long rangy weapons. He's got a really good TE kick, really good straight punches, and he's got a deceptively good front choke game.

items.claim: Gilbert Urbina is now training down at Jackson Wink gym.
